shared.saveFailed: We couldn't save it, we're trying again
shared.countExact: {count, plural, =0 {No items} one {# item} other {# items}}
shared.cursorDropped: That link to a page of results no longer works because the data changed. We're showing the first page of the same filter.

jobs.title: Job
jobs.notFoundBody: The job either never existed or is older than what we keep. The project overview shows the ones that are running.

confirm.notYetConfirmed: You haven't ticked the confirmation above the button yet.
confirm.notYetTyped: The text you typed doesn't match yet. Please check it character by character.
confirm.typeToConfirmMismatch: The text you typed doesn't match.

states.forbiddenTitle: You don't have permission for this section
states.forbiddenBody: This section requires the {permission} permission, which the {roles} roles have. Your role is {currentRole}.
states.forbiddenWhoCanHelp: The project owner or an admin can change your role.
states.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or your link is out of date.
states.offlineBody: We lost the connection. We're trying to reconnect. Your changes will be saved as soon as it works.
states.staleBody: The refresh failed, so these numbers are older.
states.readOnlyTitle: You can only view this section
states.readOnlyBody: Your {currentRole} role doesn't have the {permission} permission, so you see the values as text and can't edit them.
states.partialTitle: Part of the page didn't load

profile.title: My account
profile.lead: Details that apply across every project.

identity.title: Personal details
identity.name: Full name
identity.nameHint: Other members see your name next to your actions in the audit log.
identity.emailHint: The email is used for signing in and can't be changed yet.
identity.timezoneHint: We show times across the tool in this zone.

password.title: Change password
password.lead: Changing the password signs you out of every other device. This tab stays signed in.
password.doneBody: We ended the other sessions. You'll need to sign in again on your other devices.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.lead: Devices and browsers you're signed in from.
sessions.revokeFailed: We couldn't sign that device out. Please try again.
sessions.logoutAllDialogTitle: Sign out of every device, including this one?
sessions.logoutAllConsequence: {count, plural, =0 {We won't end any session, because no other one is running.} one {We'll end # session, this tab included.} other {We'll end # sessions, this tab included.}}
sessions.logoutAllConsequenceWork: Forms in progress on other devices will be lost.
sessions.empty: You're signed in here only. Once you sign in from another device, you'll see it in this list.

general.title: Project
general.lead: Name, address, and defaults for the {projectName} project.
general.name: Project name
general.slugHint: Used in links: /w/{slug}. Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.
general.slugChangeWarning: Changing the address breaks links you've already sent to colleagues.
general.localeHint: The language of system emails and of the public pages your recipients see.
general.timezoneHint: Campaigns are scheduled and reports are counted in this zone.

greetingEnabled.label: Greetings and the vocative case
greetingEnabled.hint: Declining names makes sense in Czech and Slovak. Other languages have no vocative case, so the whole area only takes up space.
greetingEnabled.onHint: Contacts show a Greeting column, a vocative review screen and a preview in the form, and the editor offers a ready-made greeting tag. You can also choose formal or informal address.
greetingEnabled.offHint: Greetings, the vocative case and the formal or informal choice appear nowhere. Nothing is deleted: stored forms stay, turning this back on brings them back exactly as they were, and templates that already use a greeting keep sending.
greetingEnabled.turnedOff: Greetings are off. Stored forms are kept.

addressForm.label: Greeting in emails
addressForm.hint: Applies to the emails you send to contacts. The tool's own interface always addresses you formally.
addressForm.dialogConsequence1: {count, plural, =0 {We won't recalculate the vocative for any contact, the database is still empty.} one {We'll recalculate the vocative for # contact.} other {We'll recalculate the vocative for # contacts.}}
addressForm.dialogConsequence2: The recalculation runs in the background and takes a few minutes on a large database.
addressForm.dialogConsequence3: Campaigns you've already sent don't change.
addressForm.started: We switched the greeting and we're recalculating contacts.

greetingLocale.label: Language of contact greetings
greetingLocale.hint: Greetings are built in the contact's language, not the project's: only Czech and Slovak have the vocative case. Contacts created earlier keep the language the project started with. The project language is now {target}.
greetingLocale.allAligned: {count, plural, =0 {You have no contacts yet.} one {Your only contact uses {target}, there is nothing to align.} other {All # contacts use {target}, there is nothing to align.}}
greetingLocale.mismatched: {count, plural, =0 {Every contact uses {target}, so everyone is greeted in it.} one {# contact out of {total} uses a language other than {target}, so it will be greeted in that one.} other {# contacts out of {total} use a language other than {target}, so they will be greeted in that one.}}
greetingLocale.perLocale: {locale}: {count, plural, =0 {no contacts} one {# contact} other {# contacts}}
greetingLocale.action: Align the language to {target} and recalculate greetings
greetingLocale.dialogConsequence1: {count, plural, =0 {No contact will change its language.} one {We'll change the language of # contact and compute its vocative for {target}.} other {We'll change the language of # contacts and compute their vocative for {target}.}}
greetingLocale.dialogConsequence2: Manually confirmed forms stay. Only the sentence around them is rebuilt, so "Hello Petře" becomes "Dobrý den, Petře".
greetingLocale.dialogConsequence3: The recalculation runs in the background and a contact's language can be changed back at any time.
greetingLocale.started: We're aligning the language and recalculating greetings. This takes a moment.

danger.title: Delete the project
danger.body: Deleting removes all contacts, campaigns and statistics. You can restore it for 30 days. Type the project name to confirm.
danger.consequence1: Every contact, list, segment, and tag disappears.
danger.consequence2: Every campaign, template, and their statistics disappear.
danger.consequence3: The project's API keys and webhooks stop working immediately.
danger.consequence4: Emails already sent won't come back, but a send in progress stops.
danger.restoreNote: You can restore the project for 30 days. After that it's deleted for good and can't be recovered.
danger.confirmLabel: Type the project name to confirm
danger.onlyOwner: Only the owner can delete a project.

members.title: Team
members.lead: Who can get into the project and what they can do.
members.empty: You are alone in this project. Invite colleagues and choose what they can do.
members.emptyNoPermission: Only an Admin or an Owner can invite colleagues. Your role doesn't have that permission.

roleDescription.owner: Sees and changes everything, including backups, deletion, and handing the project over.
roleDescription.admin: Sees and changes everything except backups, deletion, and handing the project over.
roleDescription.editor: Creates contacts, templates, and campaigns, and sends them. Can't see keys, the audit log, or export contacts.
roleDescription.viewer: Sees contacts, campaigns, and reports. Changes nothing.

changeRole.label: Role of {name}
changeRole.failed: We couldn't change the role. We put the original value back.
changeRole.lastOwner: The last owner has to stay. Hand ownership over to someone else first.

remove.consequence1: They lose access to every contact, campaign, and report in the project.
remove.consequence2: What they created in the project stays.
remove.consequence3: They can only get back through a new invitation, which they have to accept.
remove.done: {name} is no longer in the project.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.empty: No invitation is waiting to be accepted.
invitations.limitTitle: You can't send more invitations at once
invitations.limitBody: The project has 100 pending invitations, which is the maximum. Revoke one of them, or wait until people accept.

invite.title: Invite a colleague to the project
invite.lead: We'll send them a link that works for 7 days.
invite.alreadyMember: {email} is already in the project. You can change their role in the member list.
invite.alreadyInvited: We've sent the invitation to {email} again, the previous one stopped working.
invite.mailUnavailableTitle: Email invitations cannot be sent right now
invite.mailUnavailableBody: This installation has no way to send system email, so the invitation would never arrive. Create the colleague directly with a password in the form below, or set up system email first.

create.title: Create a member directly
create.lead: The account is created immediately, with no email. You hand over the password yourself.
create.passwordGenerated: Generate one and show it to me
create.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. It must not contain part of the address before the at sign, nor be among the ten thousand most common passwords.
create.existing: An account for {email} already existed in this installation, so we only added it to the project. We did not change its password.
create.changeHint: Tell the new member to change the password after the first sign-in under Settings, My account. Forcing a change on first sign-in is not supported yet.

orphaned.title: Accounts without a project
orphaned.lead: Accounts that exist in this installation but belong to no project. They can still sign in, yet they are not in any team list. Membership in a deleted project does not count.
orphaned.empty: There is no such account. Every account in this installation belongs to at least one project.
orphaned.name: Name
orphaned.consequence1: It stops signing in and its open sessions end immediately.
orphaned.consequence2: Whatever it created in the tool stays, with its name on it.
orphaned.consequence3: Audit records stay. They are evidence and are never deleted.
orphaned.consequence4: Its email address is free right away, so the account can be created again.
orphaned.failed: The account could not be deleted.
orphaned.cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your own account. Ask someone else to do it.
orphaned.stillMember: The account has joined a project in the meantime. Remove it from the project first.
orphaned.lastAccount: This is the last account of the installation. If it went, nobody could get back in.

password.title: The account is ready
password.warning: Copy the password now. Neither you nor we can see it again.

systemMail.title: System email
systemMail.lead: Email about accounts: invitations, forgotten password recovery and address verification in trial mode. It has nothing to do with sending campaigns.
systemMail.okBody: It is sent through the account {account} of type {type}.

reason.no_account: The project has no sending account that could send email.
reason.provider_unsupported: The project would send through the account {account} of type {type}. Only an SMTP account can send system email from here.
reason.selected_account_missing: The account chosen for system email is no longer in the project, or it is switched off.

systemMail.limitationBody: System email is composed and sent by the application itself. Only the campaign sending service, written in Go, has an Amazon SES client, so the application cannot send through an SES account. This is a known limitation of the tool, not a mistake in your setup.
systemMail.blocked1: Inviting someone to the project by email. Instead, create the member directly with a password under Settings, Team.
systemMail.blocked2: Recovering a forgotten password. Instead, run mlain reset-password with the user's address on the server.
systemMail.blocked3: Verifying an address in trial mode, so trial mode cannot be completed.
systemMail.blocked4: The notice about a disabled webhook. That one is only undelivered, the webhook is disabled either way.
systemMail.fixBody: Add an SMTP account under Settings, Sending. Campaigns can keep going through SES, system email will take the SMTP account.

fromSource.verified_domain: Derived from the verified domain of the sending account.
fromSource.app_url: Derived from the application address, because the account has no verified domain. Such a message ends up in spam more often.

form.title: Settings
form.accountHint: Which sending account system email goes out through.
form.fromAddressHint: Leave it empty and we'll derive it from the verified domain of the account.

systemMail.noAccounts: The project has no sending account yet, so there is nothing to choose from.
systemMail.noPermission: System email is configured by Admins and Owners. Your role does not have that permission.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.lead: A key connects your shop or your own application to this project.
apiKeys.empty: You do not have any API keys yet. A key connects your shop or your own application.
apiKeys.emptyNoPermission: Only an Admin or an Owner can create API keys. Your role doesn't have that permission.

status.rotating: Rotating, the old secret works until {time}

create.title: New API key
create.lead: Choose what it can do. A key has no role, it gets exactly what you tick here.
create.name: Key name
create.nameHint: The name tells you which application uses the key. For example “Shop, orders”.
create.scopesHint: Tick as few as possible. A key that can do everything is a key nobody understands.

secret.title: The key is ready
secret.warning: Copy the secret now. Neither you nor we can see it again.
secret.label: The whole key

rotate.dialogTitle: Rotate the secret of the {name} key?
rotate.consequence1: We'll generate a new secret and show it once.
rotate.consequence2: Applications using the old secret stop working once the grace period ends: {grace}.
rotate.graceLabel: Grace period for the old secret
rotate.graceHint: During this time both the old and the new secret work. Zero means the old one stops working immediately.
rotate.acknowledge: I understand the old secret will stop working

revoke.consequence1: Applications using the key stop working immediately.
revoke.consequence2: A revoked key stays in the list so the audit trail makes sense. It can't be restored.
revoke.acknowledge: I understand a revoked key can't be restored

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.lead: A webhook posts an event to your URL as soon as something happens in the project.
webhooks.empty: No webhooks yet. A webhook posts an event to your URL as soon as something happens.
webhooks.emptyAfterDelete: You deleted every webhook. Create a new one with the button below.
webhooks.emptyNoPermission: Only an Admin or an Owner can add webhooks. Your role doesn't have that permission.
webhooks.limitBody: The project has 20 webhooks, which is the maximum. Delete one before adding another.

status.failing: {count, plural, =0 {Failing} one {Failing, # failure in a row} other {Failing, # failures in a row}}

disabled.title: We disabled your webhook
disabled.body: We disabled your webhook after 20 failed attempts. Fix the target and enable it again.
disabled.detail: The endpoint {url} has been returning HTTP {lastStatus} since {since}. After twenty failed attempts we stopped delivering to avoid filling the queue.
disabled.replayNote: When you enable it, we'll offer to replay the last 24 hours of events. Anything older than that cannot be redelivered.

form.urlHint: HTTPS only. We don't post to private addresses or to your local network.
form.descriptionHint: What the webhook is for. Your colleagues see it in the list.
form.eventsHint: Pick at least one, at most 50.
form.duplicateNote: Delivery is at least once. If we restart a worker mid-send, an event can arrive twice. Tell them apart by the ML-Event-Id header.

secret.title: The webhook is ready
secret.warning: Copy the signing secret now. Neither you nor we can see it again.
secret.hint: The secret proves a request really came from us. The steps are in the documentation for the ML-Signature header.

test.slow: This is taking longer than we expected
test.successBody: You will see the result in the delivery log below, usually within a few seconds. Load it again.
test.failureTitle: The test event didn't get through
test.failureBody: Your URL answered {status}. The details are in the delivery log below.

delete.consequence1: Events stop going to this URL immediately.
delete.consequence2: The delivery log stays for 30 days.

deliveries.title: Delivery log
deliveries.lead: Delivery attempts from the last 30 days.
deliveries.empty: We haven't sent anything to this URL yet.
deliveries.emptyFilteredBody: Try loosening the filter, or clear it and go through the whole log.
deliveries.blockedTarget: The address resolves into a private network, so we didn't connect. Check whether the DNS record changed.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: Who did what in the project. Records can't be deleted or edited.
audit.emptyFilteredBody: Try loosening the filter, or clear it and go through the whole audit log.

forbidden.title: You don't have permission for this
forbidden.body: This requires the {permission} permission, which the {roles} roles have. Your role is {currentRole}.

insufficientScope.title: The key isn't enough for this
insufficientScope.body: The key the application signed in with doesn't have the {permission} permission. It can't be added, create a new key.

originNotAllowed.title: The request came from somewhere else
originNotAllowed.body: The address the request came from doesn't match the tool's address. Reload the page and try again.

csrfTokenInvalid.title: The protection token is no longer valid
csrfTokenInvalid.body: The page was open for too long. Reload it and repeat the action.

sessionExpired.title: You've been signed out
sessionExpired.body: We signed you out after a period of inactivity for security reasons. Sign in again, your work in progress is safe.

notFound.title: We couldn't find this item
notFound.body: It may have been deleted, or your link points to an item in another project.

conflict.title: Something changed meanwhile
conflict.body: Someone else edited the same thing before you did. Reload the page and look at the current state.

alreadyExists.title: This already exists
alreadyExists.body: An item with the same value is already in the project. Pick a different value.

alreadyMember.title: This person is already in the project
alreadyMember.body: There's no need to invite them. You can change their role right in the member list.

lastOwner.title: The last owner has to stay
lastOwner.body: A project always has exactly one owner. Hand ownership over to someone else first, then repeat the action.

idempotencyKeyReuse.title: The form was submitted with changed values
idempotencyKeyReuse.body: The form went out twice, the second time with different content. Reload the page and fill it in once.

idempotencyInProgress.title: We're already processing the same request
idempotencyInProgress.body: You submitted the form twice in quick succession. Wait a few seconds and look at the result.

validationFailed.title: We couldn't save the form
validationFailed.body: We've described what needs fixing next to the fields below.

tooManyItems.title: That's too many items
tooManyItems.body: You picked more items than we can handle at once. Split it into smaller parts.

rateLimited.title: You're trying too often
rateLimited.body: Wait {seconds, plural, =0 {a moment} one {# second} other {# seconds}} and try again.

webhookDisabled.title: We disabled this webhook after 20 consecutive failures
webhookDisabled.body: Once you've fixed the problem on your side, re-enable it. We'll offer to replay the last 24 hours of events.

serviceUnavailable.title: The server isn't responding
serviceUnavailable.body: We couldn't reach the tool's server. This is usually temporary and a second attempt goes through.

systemMailUnavailable.title: This installation has no way to send system email
systemMailUnavailable.body: Only an SMTP account can send it, because the Amazon SES client lives solely in the campaign sending service. You can see the state and the fix under Settings, System email. Trying again will not help, what is missing is configuration, not a connection.

dependencyTimeout.title: The server took too long
dependencyTimeout.body: We stopped the request because it ran longer than 10 seconds. Try again.

internalError.title: Something went wrong
internalError.body: The fault is on our side. Try again, and if it keeps happening, send support the request number below.

fallback.title: Something went wrong
fallback.body: The server's description of the error is below. If it doesn't help, send support the request number.
